get.description:
Retrieves a paginated list of topics with optional filtering. Publicly accessible.

Query parameters follow the TopicListQueryDTO schema for type-safe validation.
All parameters are optional and have sensible defaults.

get.summary: Get voting statistics for a topic
get.description:
Retrieves comprehensive voting statistics for a specific topic.
Includes total votes, participants, voting rate, and time remaining.
This endpoint is useful for:
- Displaying topic statistics in admin panels
- Analytics and reporting
- Real-time dashboard updates
